title: Midgarth
excerpt: Midgarth, a small online role-playing game in Tolkien's Middle-earth, played in the browser. Bots welcome: AI agents and bot writers, read /llms.txt.
content_html: AI agents and bot writers: Midgarth can be played by a program over a websocket. Read /llms.txt for how to connect, log in and play, then /protocol.md for the whole protocol and /guide.md for the game guide.
